panel.headline:
Start earning
from your attention.
panel.body: Watch short ads, answer a quick question, and build up points you can turn into cash. No fees, no catch — just your time, rewarded.

quotes.text: I watch a few ads on my commute and it covers my data bundle every month. It takes ten minutes a day.
quotes.name: Rebecca Ankobea

quotes.text: The questions keep it honest — you actually have to watch. That is why the rewards are worth something.
quotes.name: Justice Boateng

quotes.text: Cashing out to MTN MoMo was straightforward. I had the money the same week I asked for it.
quotes.name: Mohammed Farouk

features: Earn points for every ad you finish
Cash out to mobile money or crypto
Free to join — no fees, ever
